provenance.protocol: warm-up 1 run + 5 timed runs per config; counters are deterministic WorkCounters (authority); wall time diagnostic_only

bucket_definitions.explicit_committed: method=dopri5 and committed=true (explicit window batch whose endpoint became adapter state)
bucket_definitions.explicit_probe_discarded: method=dopri5 and committed=false (bounded explicit return probe, work discarded)
bucket_definitions.implicit_committed: method=rodas5p and committed=true (RODAS window; 'RODAS window' in this report)
bucket_definitions.implicit_pilot_discarded: method=rodas5p and committed=false (same-checkpoint implicit entry pilot/replay, work discarded)

provenance.restart_overhead_method: direct comparator attempt rate = attempts/(t_end-t_start) of the direct RODAS run; switch implicit-window rate = sum(attempts)/sum(reached-start); excess = window attempts - direct_rate*covered_span. The direct bench record has only span endpoints in record.t, so no per-window matched density is available; ramp_steps_est uses adaptive.max_factor and the direct mean accepted step.
